name: tetrilaunch-workspace
description: Tetrilaunch — marketing-only public site and D1 API; native game in app/.

scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply tetrilaunch-leaderboard-preview --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply tetrilaunch-leaderboard-preview --local --env staging
scripts.test:marketing: node marketing/build.test.mjs && node tests/marketing-distribution.mjs && node tests/marketing-retirement.mjs
